root = Stack([title, panels, recommendation])
title = TextContent("Checkout Variant Comparison", "large-heavy")
panels = Stack([conversionPanel, orderPanel, bouncePanel, revenuePanel], "row", "m", "stretch", "start", true)
conversionPanel = Card([conversionHeader, conversionChart])
conversionHeader = CardHeader("Conversion Rate", "Higher is better")
conversionChart = BarChart(variants, [conversionSeries], "grouped", "Variant", "Percent", 240)
orderPanel = Card([orderHeader, orderChart])
orderHeader = CardHeader("Average Order Value", "Higher is better")
orderChart = BarChart(variants, [orderSeries], "grouped", "Variant", "Dollars", 240)
bouncePanel = Card([bounceHeader, bounceChart])
bounceHeader = CardHeader("Bounce Rate", "Lower is better")
bounceChart = BarChart(variants, [bounceSeries], "grouped", "Variant", "Percent", 240)
revenuePanel = Card([revenueHeader, revenueChart])
revenueHeader = CardHeader("Expected Revenue per Session", "Conversion × average order value")
revenueChart = BarChart(variants, [revenueSeries], "grouped", "Variant", "Dollars", 240)
recommendation = Callout("success", "Ship Variant D", "Express pay first leads conversion at 3.9%, has the lowest bounce rate at 35%, and produces the highest expected revenue per session at $1.91. Its $49 average order value is lower, so monitor order value after launch.")
variants = ["A", "B", "C", "D"]
conversionSeries = Series("Conversion Rate", [3.1, 3.6, 3.3, 3.9])
orderSeries = Series("Average Order Value", [54, 51, 56, 49])
bounceSeries = Series("Bounce Rate", [41, 37, 40, 35])
revenueSeries = Series("Expected Revenue per Session", [1.674, 1.836, 1.848, 1.911])
